messages:
maya: Heads-up — launching webinar promo Fri 9AM PT. Planning 48h paid burst. Need search + retarget creative refresh and pacing. Target CPL $45. Thoughts?
sam: Love it. Geo? landing page? mandatory CTAs?
maya: US+CA, prioritize CA, NY, TX, WA, IL. LP v3 (drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/webinar-lp-v3). CTAs: Register & Watch on-demand.
jess: Budget: $6k total — $3.5k search, $2k retarget, $500 experiments. Pacing: frontload ~60% in first 12h, then steady. If CPL > $60 after 18h, throttle.
liam: Search recs: max CPC $3.20, broad+phrase, RSAs with fresh headlines. Device bids: mobile -10%. Use sitelinks for agenda.
liam: quick campaign snippet:
```
campaign: webinar_burst_mar24
budget_daily: 3000
bidding: manual_cpc
max_cpc: 3.2
keywords: +developer +llm +inference "model serving"
ads: RSA x3
```
jess: We'll A/B hero image A(product screenshot) vs B(team photo). utm_content to differentiate.
ads-bot: daily-sync: last burst avg CPC $2.85, CVR 1.6%, avg CPL $39 — baseline: https://ads.redwood.ai/reports/last-burst :bar_chart: 
olivia: SDR routing: send inbound leads to queue inbound-webinar. Tag high intent if utm_content contains "register" and session_length >30s. I can wire Zapier->HubSpot.
maya: Mapping: name,email,company,role,utm_source,utm_medium,utm_campaign,utm_content. Tag: webinar-mar24-burst. Exclude internal emails.
sam: Tracking: GA4 + server-side event required. Append utm params: ?utm_source=paid&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=webinar_burst&utm_content=creativeA
liam: Retargeting: 30d window, exclude converters last 7d, freq cap 4/day. Creatives: reminder, social-proof, quick-FAQ. Use dynamic templates.
jess: Add a lookalike from last webinar converters (~2k). Start 1% and expand if CPA holds.
olivia: SDR rota: weekend coverage Sat-Sun 9am-3pm PT. I'll post rota link.
maya: I'll update campaign sheet with final budgets, creative links, and ad manager CSV by EOD. Ping me for approvals.
sam: QA note: check LP mobile form — last time CTA hidden. If broken, kill mobile bids.
liam: On it, running smoke check now. Will share logs.
jess: Reserve $500 scaling buffer for top queries mid-burst.
maya: Marked $500 buffer.
ads-bot: reminder: upload final creatives by 18:00 today or default to asset A.
olivia: Confirming SDR mapping once I see form fields.
maya: Thanks all — will post final sheet link when done. :white_check_mark:
